name: 32034 · Fern Bch, FL
findings: ZIP 32034 (Fern Bch) has 187 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 50 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32034 (Fern Bch) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
